svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Sequence of a server create: the customer asks Central; Central checks the plan and calls Atlas; Atlas saves a draft and calls Metal, which saves the request and replies 202; Metal clones the disk and boots the VM; host sync reports the VM as running and Atlas sends a state webhook to Central; Pilot in the VM enrolls with Central, and Central writes the site route to the HTTP proxy.

text.tspan: 2. check plan · save action · queue job
